mission.title: Agent Information
mission.description: Prevent two Zion Operatives from becoming a problem.

phase.briefing:
There are two Zion operatives we must eliminate before they impart certain ... information to the Zion Council. As you may know, killing the humans would violate the Truce, so we have to be very delicate with this matter.
You will be picking up a pair of RSI shells of Exiles and leading them into the Zion base where the two Zion targets reside. Once you have eliminated the Zion forces, search the bodies of the operatives for the vital information, and then leave the fake Exiles behind as evidence of a Merovingian raid.

enter.say: Find Agent Harrow. He'll have the programs for you and additional details on your assignment.

objective.text: Lead the two programs out of the area
Do not let Gaspard or Benedetto die

phase.briefing: Now that the programs are with you, I will send you the address of the targets. They are known as Capella and Tycho. Enter the base and kill everyone you find. Then leave the Exiles' program Shells as evidence to frame the Merovingian.

enter.say: See to it that the information they hold does not make it into the hands of the Zion council.

objective.text: Lead the Exile programs to the Zion targets
Search the corpses of the Zion operatives

phase.briefing: Agent Harrow has informed me that he will meet you at an office building that is close to your current location. I am sending you the coordinates now.

enter.say: Agent Harrow is waiting for you.

objective.text: Give the dossier to Agent Harrow
